From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Cc:

Subject: Fwd: Acme quote — request for exec exception (deal D-2026-ACME-114)

Team — forwarding Acme's procurement note plus competitor quote. Need an exception on committed pricing for a strategic account (they'll be a reference in Q4). Summary:
- Request: Match competitor within ~5% on committed monthly rate for a 12-month reserved commit covering a 16x GPU pool (mix of A100-equivalent instances)
- Customer requires throughput SLA: p99 inference <200ms at baseline traffic; we already support KV caching and batching but want this formalized in SOW
- Business case: $1.2M ARR if they sign; fast PO expected if we can close this week

Proposed counter (two options):
A) Price-match-ish: 18% one-year committed discount + $75,000 onboarding credit (applied against first two invoices) + written throughput appendix that commits to p99 <200ms with defined traffic profile
B) Conservative: 22% discount but requires 24-month commitment and smaller onboarding credit ($35k)

Asks:
- Ben: can Sales Ops model the margin impact and confirm whether $75k credit is acceptable?
- Marissa: will Legal need any special language for the throughput appendix?
- Evelyn: need exec signoff for any deviation >15% off list.

Attachments: ACME_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.docx (draft MAP), Acme_competitor-quote.pdf

—Laura

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme quote — request for exec exception (deal D-2026-ACME-114)

Laura — ran numbers with Sales Ops. Key points:
- List economics allow up to a 20% off standard committed rate without hitting approval floors; beyond 20% we need director-level signoff and finance memo.
- $75k onboarding credit is feasible if we convert to a non-refundable implementation credit tied to milestones (kickoff + staging + production). That preserves economics.
- Throughput SLA appendix: Ops can commit to p99 <200ms for the stated profile, but we must include an exclusion clause for traffic spikes outside the agreed QPS profile and require a runbook/observability integration (token-level tracing + sampling).

Recommendation (single counter to present to Acme):
- 18% committed discount (12-month term), $75k onboarding credit (milestone-based, non-refundable), and a throughput appendix with explicit traffic profile + escalation steps.
- Attach the finance summary and a one-page exec approval template. I can send to Evelyn for sign.

If Evelyn approves, we should aim to present this as "executive good-faith package" rather than a permanent price change.

—Ben
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
